kinds: objlit-exported
a direct method or function-valued property of an object literal that is exported (export const X = {...}, export default {...}, module.exports = {...}, exports.x = {...})
objlit-module-const
the same, of an object literal bound to a module-level const that is not exported
objlit-other
a method or function-valued property of any other object literal (nested literal, local literal, argument, let)
exports-assign
the right side of module.exports = f, exports.x = f, module.exports.x = f
prop-assign
the right side of any other property assignment a.b = f, a[k] = f
class-field
a class field initialised with a function or arrow
class-other
a class member not listed (a class expression, a nested or unnamed class, a computed or private name)
callback
an argument of a call or new
iife
the callee of a call (an immediately invoked function)
nested
a function declaration or a variable initialiser inside another function
top-other
a module-level declaration not listed (let or var, several declarators, an anonymous default export)
other
anything else (a return value, an array element, a JSX attribute, a default parameter, a conditional)
